from warehouse import q

# Leaderboard

## Row {height=22%}

```{python}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Games ranked"
dict(value=int(q("select count(*) as n from marts.game_leaderboard").n[0]))
```

```{python}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Players at the latest hour"
players = q("""
  select sum(current_player_count) as n
  from marts.game_leaderboard
  where current_hour = (select max(current_hour) from marts.game_leaderboard)
""").n[0]
dict(icon="people", value=f"{int(players):,}")
```

```{python}
#| content: valuebox
latest = q("select max(current_hour) as h from marts.game_leaderboard").h[0]
```

::: {.valuebox icon="clock" color="dark"}
Latest observed hour, `{python} f"{latest:%Y-%m-%d}"` UTC

`{python} f"{latest:%H:%M}"`
:::

```{python}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Games behind the latest hour"
stale = int(q("""
  select count(*) as n
  from marts.game_leaderboard
  where current_hour < (select max(current_hour) from marts.game_leaderboard)
""").n[0])
dict(icon="hourglass-split", value=stale, color="warning" if stale else "light")
```

## Row

### Column {width=45%}

```{python}
#| title: "Top 15 by current players"
ranked_bars(
  q("""
    select app_name, current_player_count
    from marts.game_leaderboard
    order by current_rank
    limit 15
  """),
  value="current_player_count",
  label="app_name",
)
```

### Column

```{python}
#| title: "Every tracked game"
table = q("""
  select
    current_rank as "Rank",
    app_name as "Game",
    current_player_count as "Players now",
    round(avg_player_count_7d) as "7-day avg",
    rank_7d as "7-day rank",
    peak_player_count_record as "Record peak",
    days_since_peak as "Days since peak",
    to_char(current_hour at time zone 'utc', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:00') as "Latest hour (UTC)"
  from marts.game_leaderboard
  order by current_rank
""")
table.style.hide(axis="index").format(thousands=",", precision=0)
```

# Pipeline

```{python}
#| include: false
by_status = q("select status, count(*) as n from marts.fct_snapshot_hours group by status")
by_status = dict(zip(by_status.status, by_status.n, strict=True))
hwm = q("select logical_hour as h from marts.fct_snapshot_hours where is_high_water_mark").h[0]
unobservable = int(q("select count(*) as n from marts.dim_game where is_unobservable").n[0])
```

## Row {height=20%}

::: {.valuebox icon="flag" color="dark"}
High-water mark, `{python} f"{hwm:%Y-%m-%d}"` UTC

`{python} f"{hwm:%H:%M}"`
:::

```{python}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Hours complete"
{"icon": "check-circle", "value": int(by_status.get("complete", 0))}
```

```{python}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Hours the warehouse heard nothing"
unrecorded = int(by_status.get("unrecorded", 0))
{"icon": "x-circle", "value": unrecorded, "color": "danger" if unrecorded else "light"}
```

```{python}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Games Steam publishes no count for"
{"icon": "eye-slash", "value": unobservable}
```

## Row {height=48%}

```{python}
#| title: "Every hour since the first observation, by status (UTC)"
status_grid(
  q("""
    select
      (logical_hour at time zone 'utc')::date as day,
      extract(hour from logical_hour at time zone 'utc')::int as hour,
      status,
      status || coalesce(
        ': ' || observed_count || ' of ' || tracked_count || ' observed', ''
      ) as hover
    from marts.fct_snapshot_hours
  """)
)
```

## Row

### Column

```{python}
#| title: "Games observed per hour"
lines(
  q("""
    select logical_hour, snapshot_rows
    from marts.fct_snapshot_hours
    order by 1
  """),
  x="logical_hour",
  ys=["snapshot_rows"],
  names=["Games"],
)
```

### Column

```{python}
#| title: "Steam call latency per hour, milliseconds log scale"
lines(
  q("select logical_hour, latency_p50_ms, latency_max_ms from marts.fct_snapshot_hours order by 1"),
  x="logical_hour",
  ys=["latency_p50_ms", "latency_max_ms"],
  names=["Median", "Max"],
  log_y=True,
)
```
